title: SCE formal models manifest (wire schema v1)
description: What a repository declares of its TLA+ models, judged by `sce-codegen formal models --manifest <file>` (docs/adr/0146, D1; docs/adr/0115, D5 and D9). Written by the repository beside its modules and configurations, which are read relative to this file's directory; never emitted by SCE. Every module and configuration in that directory is declared, every part of a model has a run that takes it out, and everything a holding run checks has a run that shows it can fail; an inductive invariant a model states is checked by Apalache for every length of execution at a configuration's parameters, and has a run that shows it can fail (docs/adr/0115, D3). No tool is named here: the judge pins its tools (docs/adr/0146, D3). Authoritative reader is sce-build/src/formal/models.rs, which refuses a key it does not know as `formal/declaration`. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone; see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md.

decision.description: The record that decides what the model is of.

parts.description: Each constant that switches a piece of the protocol, with the value that keeps it in.

promise.description: The temporal property that states the refinement of the abstract module `refines` names.

abstract.description: A promise, run only by what refines it.

no_progress.description: Why the model states no progress.

possible.description: State predicates p with AG EF p.

inductive.description: Inductive invariants, each checked by Apalache for every length of execution at a configuration's parameters (docs/adr/0115, D3): Init implies it (base), a step from it keeps it (step), and it implies each theorem (implies).

invariant.description: The operator of the module that is the inductive invariant.

types.description: The operator that gives every variable a value of its type (Apalache's Gen, for a sequence), conjoined with the invariant where the step and the implication start; absent when the invariant's first conjuncts give every variable one.

implies.description: The theorems it proves, each a property a holding run of the model checks.

config.description: The configuration whose CONSTANTS fix the parameters.

obligation.description: The obligation a violating run fails; those before it must hold.

without.description: The part a violating run takes out.

against.description: The assumption a violating run goes against.

states.description: The distinct states a holding run explores.

without.description: The part a violating run takes out.

against.description: The assumption a violating run goes against.

why.description: Why a part is there when the promise is kept without it.
